**BLUF**

Russian overnight strikes on Ukraine (detailed in multiple outlets on 12 Sep) killed at least 11 civilians and injured dozens more, with Ukrainian air defences claiming 110 of ~129 drones/missiles downed; Kyiv conducted reciprocal strikes on Russian industrial and shadow-fleet targets. Houthi seizure of Perim Island has halved Bab el-Mandeb ship traffic, tightening pressure on Red Sea routes and pushing oil prices higher. Taiwan MND reported baseline PLA activity (7 aircraft/8 vessels, 5 crossing median line) on the 12 Sep reporting period. Belarus President Lukashenko ordered comprehensive army inspections down to mobilization readiness. CISA/FBI issued updated Akira ransomware guidance on 12 Sep alongside ongoing KEV catalog updates with federal patch deadlines.

## 1. STANDING THEATRE SWEEP

### EUROPE / RUSSIA-UKRAINE
- [OSINT - CONFIRMED] Reuters, Euronews, Kyiv Independent, RFE/RL and RBC-Ukraine (12 Sep, morning/afternoon UTC) reported Russian missile/drone strikes overnight into 12 Sep killed at least 11 civilians and injured ~96 across multiple regions, with Odesa hardest hit (residential building damaged, 35+ injured including infant); Ukrainian Air Force stated ~129 drones (incl. jet-powered Shaheds), Iskander/KN-23 ballistic missiles, Kalibr and Kh-59/69 cruise missiles were used, with 110 targets destroyed/suppressed and hits at 20 locations.[[1]](https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-attacks-kill-six-injure-dozens-ukraine-moscow-says-it-hits-ships-plants-2026-09-12/)[[2]](https://www.euronews.com/my-europe/2026/09/12/at-least-11-killed-in-russian-attacks-on-ukraine-as-kyiv-strikes-russias-shadow-fleet)
- [OSINT - CONFIRMED] Ukrainian officials and independent reporting (12 Sep) noted Kyiv struck Russian shadow-fleet assets, chemical industry facilities in Samara and Perm regions, and other logistics targets in retaliation.[[3]](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1552080/russia-and-ukraine-exchange-deadly-drone-strikes/)
- [HUMINT - ASSESSED] Belarus President Lukashenko (11-12 Sep) ordered inspections of the entire armed forces, including mobilization readiness, artillery and other units, to be conducted under near-combat conditions.[[4]](https://mezha.net/eng/news/99e78814_lukashenko_orders_belarus_to/)

### MIDDLE EAST
- [OSINT - CONFIRMED] The National, NPR, BBC and Guardian (12 Sep, early UTC) reported ship traffic through Bab el-Mandeb halved to ~15 crossings on 12 Sep following Houthi seizure of Perim (Mayyun) Island and Mokha; Houthi spokesman stated navigation safe except for Saudi vessels, with oil prices rising above $100/bbl amid the tightening control.[[5]](https://www.thenationalnews.com/business/energy/2026/09/12/ship-traffic-in-bab-al-mandeb-strait-halves-as-houthis-seize-control-of-key-island/)[[6]](https://www.npr.org/2026/09/12/g-s1-143044/yemens-houthis-capture-red-sea-island)

### INDO-PACIFIC
- [OSINT - CONFIRMED] Taiwan News / MND (12 Sep, reporting period ending ~06:00 local 12 Sep) tracked 7 Chinese military aircraft (5 crossing median line into northern/southwestern ADIZ) and 8 naval/official vessels; Taiwan responded with aircraft, ships and missile systems.[[7]](https://www.taiwannews.com.tw/en/news/6438650)

### SOUTH AND CENTRAL ASIA
Quiet in window. No verifiable new developments matching standing requirements or otherwise consequential.

### AFRICA
Quiet in window. No verifiable new developments matching standing requirements or otherwise consequential.

### AMERICAS
Quiet in window. No verifiable new developments matching standing requirements or otherwise consequential.

### STRATEGIC AND SPACE
Quiet in window. No verifiable new developments matching standing requirements or otherwise consequential.

### ECONOMIC AND ENERGY PRESSURE
- [OSINT - CONFIRMED] Multiple outlets (12 Sep) noted Bab el-Mandeb traffic halved and Brent crude closing near $104-110/bbl tied to Houthi advances; no independent confirmation of new chokepoint incidents beyond prior seizure.[[5]](https://www.thenationalnews.com/business/energy/2026/09/12/ship-traffic-in-bab-al-mandeb-strait-halves-as-houthis-seize-control-of-key-island/)

## 2. TECHNOLOGY AND CYBERSECURITY
- [SIGINT - VERIFIED] CISA (12 Sep) published updated joint guidance with FBI on Akira ransomware targeting small businesses and critical infrastructure.[[8]](https://insidecybersecurity.com/daily-news/cisa-fbi-update-guidance-ransomware-threat-impacting-small-businesses)
- [SIGINT - VERIFIED] CISA KEV catalog updates continued, with federal patch deadlines active (e.g., recent additions including JFrog, ConnectWise, MikroTik flaws).[[9]](https://thehackernews.com/2026/09/cisa-adds-5-actively-exploited.html)

## 3. HOMELAND AND INFRASTRUCTURE
Quiet in window. No incidents affecting civil aviation, rail, ports, power, water, or telecoms reported. No change to domestic critical infrastructure posture.

## 4. UAP/UFO
Quiet in window. No official statements, hearings or document releases.

## 5. FRONTIER AND CONSCIOUSNESS RESEARCH
Quiet in window. No peer-reviewed publications or funded programme announcements matching focus.

**Assessment (Europe/Russia-Ukraine):** The 12 Sep reporting cycle confirms and adds granularity to the prior overnight Russian barrage while documenting Ukrainian deep strikes on Russian economic targets; the net effect sustains mutual attrition on infrastructure and logistics without decisive territorial shift. Belarus mobilization-readiness checks add a low-level but verifiable signal of heightened preparedness that could support or complicate Russian operations. Position of neither side materially improved; watch for Ukrainian follow-on strikes or Russian energy targeting.

**Assessment (Middle East):** Houthi consolidation on Perim tightens de-facto control over a critical chokepoint, directly visible in halved traffic and oil-price pressure; Saudi and coalition responses remain limited to prior patterns. This incrementally worsens shipping economics and raises escalation risk for non-Saudi vessels.

**Assessment (Indo-PACIFIC):** PLA activity remained within established gray-zone parameters; no surge detected.

**Assessment (Tech/Cyber):** CISA actions reflect ongoing operational tempo against ransomware and edge-device vulnerabilities rather than a new campaign.

**INDICATORS AND WARNINGS**
- Expanded Houthi attacks or effective blockade on non-Saudi shipping through Bab el-Mandeb → further insurance spikes and Suez rerouting → first visible in Lloyd’s List or maritime traffic data.
- Belarus mobilization orders or large-scale exercises near Ukrainian border → heightened NATO air policing or intelligence alerts → first in Belarus state media or Ukrainian reporting.
- Confirmed exploitation of new JFrog/ConnectWise or recent Cisco/Citrix KEVs in critical infrastructure → broader campaign targeting edge devices → CISA incident notification or sector alerts.
- Surge in PLA aircraft/naval activity east of Taiwan beyond baseline → testing of blockade or gray-zone escalation → Taiwan MND daily reports.
- Additional Ukrainian strikes on Russian refining/logistics → Russian retaliation on Ukrainian energy/urban targets → Ukrainian Air Force or regional governor statements.

**COLLECTION GAPS**
- Independent confirmation of exact damage and casualties from Russian strikes on Ukrainian sites and any Ukrainian deep strikes in the window.
- Full scope of Houthi control over Perim Island and any immediate shipping incidents or Saudi/coalition responses.
- Details on any Belarus mobilization timeline or specific units affected.
- Verification of any unreported strikes or incidents in quiet theatres (South/Central Asia, Africa, Americas).
